text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly before summer training camp began, 
Tokai Teio, who was on the verge of 
claiming the undefeated Triple Crown, 
suffered a fracture. It was reported that 
her entry in the Kikuka Sho was hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A full recovery would take six months—yet 
Tokai Teio was already undergoing rehab, 
declaring that she would make it in time 
for the Kikuka Sho no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's impossible, I'll do it. 
Because it's impossible, that's why I'll 
do it. She knew from the start the road 
would be steep, and so she vows never to 
stop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, summer training camp arrives. 
Yamanin Zephyr wears a radiant, refreshed 
expression, and declares that she will 
charge full speed toward her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The road to her idol is steep, and it's 
only natural for the hurdles to be high. 
Having found a positive mindset thanks to 
Tokai Teio, Yamanin Zephyr's summer 
begins.
